filmed: Rendered frame by frame from an HTML page: a drawn phone in the middle of the frame, one caption block above it. Chrome's install dialog and the Android home screen are drawn. A drawn finger (white circle, purple ring) presses each tap and leaves a ripple.
timing_note: exact: the film is drawn at t = frame/30 from scene durations 1.9+3.4+3.2+3.1+4.3+3.0 = 18.9 s, which equals the file. title: Tampon for a customer without their phone (by phone number)
purpose: Explainer to send owners: a customer without their phone gets the tampon from their phone number, in a perfume shop where the counter asks which perfume.
made_by: v2/scripts/explainer-phone.mjs (as of commit e32419a, which made this file)
filmed: Live screen recording (Playwright, 432x768, scaled to 720x1280) of the real app on a local dev server: a robot owner «Bader» with the perfume shop «Sultan al oud», a robot customer «أحمد» with 2 tampons already. The step line is a dark rounded box (white bold text, purple number badge) injected into the page, at the bottom (step 2 at the top). The finger is an injected white dot with an orange ring that slides to each target and shrinks on the press; the clicks are real.
timing_note: approximate (±0.2 s): a live recording with fixed waits (600, 1800, 800+180 per tap, 900, 1500, 700, 1200, 8 digits × 170, 1800, 1500, 900, 1500, 3500 ms) plus page loads, trimmed 0.6 s at the start. Times below are anchored on visible changes measured in the file with ffprobe scene scores (0.68 caption 1, 4.20 camera opens, 5.08 caption 2, 8.40 typing screen, 11.3–12.7 digits, 13.44 customer found, 14.72 caption 4, 17.64 tampon given, 19.84 last caption). Each caption stays until the next replaces it. Step 5 «انزل على «زيد تامبون»» is in the script but never appears: in this app version tapping the perfume gives the tampon itself, so the script finds no «زيد تامبون» button and skips that step — the sequence jumps from 4 to ✓.

steps.screen: Owner's home (/shop) of «Sultan al oud», no caption yet.

steps.text: الحريف ما عندوش التليفون؟ انزل على «سكاني»
steps.tap: «سكاني» on the owner's home — dot slides in ~2.6 s, press ~3.5 s
steps.screen: Owner's home until ~4.2 s, then the counter's camera screen (dark fake camera). Caption at the bottom.

steps.text: انزل على «اكتب الكود»
steps.tap: the white button «اكتب الكود» under the camera — press ~7.3 s
steps.screen: Camera screen «زيد تامبون», hint «حط الكود متاع الحريف في وسط الإيكران», button «اكتب الكود». Caption box moved to the top. At ~8.4 s the typing screen opens.

steps.text: اكتب النومرو متاع الحريف
steps.tap: the code/number field — press ~10.4 s; then the customer's 8-digit number (a test robot's 9xxxxxxx) types itself ~11.3–12.7 s
steps.screen: Counter «زيد تامبون» with tabs «سكاني» / «اكتب الكود», field label «الكود (6 أرقام) ولا النومرو متاعو». At ~13.4 s the customer is found: «أحمد» with his card count, «على شنوّة التامبون؟» and six perfume buttons «Parfum 30 ml», «Parfum 50 ml», «Parfum 100 ml», «Parfum 30 ml CP», «Parfum 50 ml CP», «Parfum 100 ml CP».

steps.text: انزل على البارفان اللي خذاه
steps.tap: «Parfum 50 ml» — dot slides ~16.3 s, press ~17.2 s
steps.screen: Perfume buttons; at ~17.6 s the tampon is given and the counter shows its done state («+1 لـأحمد!»).

steps.text: خلاص! التامبون تسجّل للحريف، على البارفان اللي خذاه
steps.screen: Counter's done screen, finger dot hidden; held to the end.

timing_note: approximate (±0.2 s): live recording with waits (1200; per prize: type at 110 ms/char, 260, click «زيد كادو», 520; 500; save; 1500; switch; 2200 ms) sped up 1.6×. Anchored on changes measured in the file with ffprobe (0.54 page painted, typing 1.67–2.25 / 2.96–3.54 / 4.12–4.67, prizes added 2.46 / 3.67 / 4.96, save 5.71, saved ~8.08, switch ~10.4–11.3). title: Wheel won (what a customer sees)
purpose: First slide of the owners' news note about the wheel: what a customer sees — a full card, the wheel with three prizes, the spin, the prize with confetti.
filmed: Live screen recording (Playwright, 540x960) of the real customer card page /c/<id> on a dev server: the wheel popup opens by itself over the card (robot shop «Café Pointili», customer «نور», prizes «قهوة بلاش» 34%, «كرواسون» 33%, «ريميز 20%» 33%). Cut from 1.2 s, sped up 1.25×, cropped to y 150–810 (the popup's × is cut off). No caption overlay, no finger: all text is the app's own.
timing_note: approximate but measured: waits are 2200 ms before the hub tap and 7000 ms after; the wheel's turn is a 4.6 s CSS transition (3.68 s at 1.25×). Times below come from ffprobe scene scores in the file: hub tapped ~1.46 s («…»), spin 1.875–5.55 s, prize at 5.58 s (brightness jumps), confetti to ~7.1 s. The prize is «قهوة بلاش»: the pixel colour under the pointer in the last frame is that slice's purple (#6C47FF).
